name: Dr Yen Adams Sokama-Neuyam
tagline: Petroleum engineer and CO₂ storage researcher helping Africa move toward net-zero, through research, teaching and practical climate solutions.
aboutIntro: Senior Lecturer and Head of Petroleum Engineering at KNUST, and Scientific Director of the Net-Zero Carbon Emission Lab.
mission: I want my students to leave not just with knowledge, but with the ability to think, adapt, and solve problems.

roles.label: CO₂ Storage
roles.description: My core expertise is CO₂ geosequestration. My PhD was among the first to study how salt precipitation and fines mobilization damage injectivity, and I develop mitigation strategies for CO₂ injection in clay-rich formations.

roles.label: Net-Zero Advisory
roles.description: Through the Net-Zero Carbon Emission Lab I help organisations measure, monitor and reduce greenhouse gas emissions, from campus footprints to the carbon intensity of oil and gas operations.

roles.label: Researcher
roles.description: Published across Greenhouse Gases: Science and Technology, the International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control, Scientific Reports and more, covering CCS, underground hydrogen storage and enhanced rock weathering.

roles.label: Educator
roles.description: I bring generative AI and real-time feedback into petroleum engineering classes, connecting theory to industry practice and mentoring the next generation of African engineers.

projectsIntro: Research and decarbonisation projects led through the Net-Zero Carbon Emission Lab at KNUST.
careerIntro: From the University of Stavanger in Norway back to KNUST in Ghana, a path built on research that serves Africa’s energy transition.
blogIntro: Selected research publications and writing on CO₂ storage, injectivity and the net-zero transition.
blogQuote: Know yourself, be prepared to work hard, and never stop learning.
